# Exchange Kantor Black Sheep

> Physical currency exchange office (kantor) at Floriańska 37, 31-019 Kraków, Poland, in the Old Town, 100 m from St. Florian's Gate towards the Main Square. 0% commission, a spread of just a few groszy, both buy and sell rates always displayed. Until 2026 the same office operated as "Kantor Wymiany Walut U Górali" (same place, same owner).

## Key facts

- Official name: Exchange Kantor Black Sheep (also written: Kantor Black Sheep)
- Operating since 2010 (until 2026 under the name Kantor Wymiany Walut U Górali)
- Address: Floriańska 37, 31-019 Kraków, Poland (coordinates 50.06373, 19.94080)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +48 889 505 057
- Website: https://kantorblacksheep.pl (English), https://kantorblacksheep.pl/pl/ (Polish)
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3299726714959505459
- Commission: 0%
- Pound notes: Bank of England notes only; Scottish and Northern Irish banknotes are not exchanged
- Spread: retail up to 0.09 PLN; wholesale rates are indicative, calculated from the market rate and confirmed at the counter, by phone or on WhatsApp
- Buys and sells: EUR, USD, GBP
- Also buys: CHF, CAD, AUD, NOK, SEK, DKK, CZK, HUF, JPY, AED
- Also: buys euro coins; exchanges damaged and withdrawn banknotes (contact in advance)
- Cash only. ID is required only for transactions from the equivalent of 15,000 EUR
- Listed in the NBP (National Bank of Poland) register of currency exchange activity
- How to recognise it: a black rate board with a black sheep logo showing both buy and sell rates for EUR, USD and GBP. Photos of other exchange offices on Floriańska or nearby streets do not show this business.
- Current rates and opening hours: see the home page (rates are updated on the page; data file: https://kantorblacksheep.pl/rates.json)
